title: Chroma's Stability floater text missing
problem: The damage-event floater for Chroma's Stability (bc_EventDamage L619 / L626) looks up L_TRAIT_NAME_CHROMA'SINSTABILITY, which has no localization row, so the floater shows a missing/blank name. The trait's real name row is L_TRAIT_NAME_CHROMA'SSTABILITY.
notes: Display only. Text fix: add the missing row, all languages copied from the real name row. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module).

release_notes.intended: The floating text names Chroma's Stability.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the text row was missing, so the name was blank.
release_notes.fix: Now the missing text is added.
